# Kanvas One

> Kanvas One designs, builds and looks after websites for small businesses in the UK, with a North East team working across Newcastle, North Tyneside and Northumberland. A business sees its new website free within 24 hours, before paying anything. If they like it, it goes live for £12.50, then costs £25 a month with the web address, hosting, security, support and a change every month included. No setup fee, no VAT, no contract: cancel any month.

## The offer

- Free design first: send a business name and a link to the business anywhere online (Facebook, Instagram, an old website). A real page is designed and emailed within 24 hours. No card needed. If they don't like it, they owe nothing.
- Starter, £25 a month: the website, built for them, with their own web address (domain), hosting, security, a contact or quote form, click to call, Google and AI search set up, and one change a month made by the team. 50% off the first month (£12.50 to go live).
- Business, £50 a month: everything in Starter plus online bookings, payments, live chat, reviews asked for automatically and unlimited changes within 48 hours.
- Max, £250 a month: a growth service that also runs the business's Facebook and Instagram ads and works on its Google ranking every month. The business pays its own ad spend.
- Annual: £250 a year for Starter (two months free).
- Live on the business's own web address the same day they join. If they leave, the web address is transferred to them free.

## How it compares with a local web design agency

A small business website from a local agency typically costs £1,000 to £3,000 or more up front, takes weeks, and often bills hosting and changes on top. Kanvas One shows the design before any payment, costs £12.50 to go live and £25 a month all in, and is online the next day.

## Who it's for

Small and local businesses that need a proper website without agency prices: trades (electricians, heating engineers, plumbers), hairdressers, barbers, lash artists, makeup artists, nail techs, cake makers, kids' clubs, dance schools, gyms, driving instructors, mobile car valeters, cleaners, gardeners, tutors, photographers and coffee shops.

## Areas

Based in the North East of England. Web design for Newcastle upon Tyne (Gosforth, Jesmond, Heaton, Gateshead), North Tyneside (North Shields, Tynemouth, Whitley Bay, Wallsend, Killingworth) and Northumberland (Cramlington, Blyth, Morpeth, Ashington, Bedlington, Hexham, Alnwick, Berwick-upon-Tweed). Everything is done online, so businesses anywhere in the UK can use it.
